lines.beaver_en: Your exam is tomorrow, right? How do you feel?
lines.en: My heart's already pounding. The tension is huge.

lines.beaver_en: Me too. But did you prepare well?
lines.en: Yeah, the notice said 'chapters 1 and 2,' so I did them all.
lines.roman: eung, gongjie 'iljang mit ijang'iraeseo da haesseo.

lines.beaver_en: But they say the exam range suddenly grew.
lines.en: Really? That's absurd. I'm a bit upset.

lines.beaver_en: Up to chapters 3 and 4. So frustrating, right?
lines.learner: 응, 답답해. 겁내지 않으려 해도 자꾸 겁나.
lines.en: Yeah, it's frustrating. I try not to be scared, but I keep getting scared.
lines.roman: eung, dapdapae. geomnaeji aneuryeo haedo jakku geomna.

lines.beaver: 결과가 안 좋으면 어떻게 할 거야?
lines.beaver_en: What will you do if the result is bad?
lines.beaver_roman: gyeolgwaga an joeumyeon eotteoke hal geoya?
lines.learner: 실망은 하겠지만, 다시 도전해 볼 거야.
lines.en: I'll be disappointed, but I'll try again.
lines.roman: silmangeun hagetjiman, dasi dojeonhae bol geoya.

lines.beaver_en: That's great. But you're still pretty anxious, right?
lines.en: Honestly, my mood keeps going up and down.

lines.beaver_en: What do you want to do after the exam?
lines.en: I want to have a blast with my friends.

lines.beaver_en: Nice! How would you feel if you passed?
lines.learner: 감격해서 울 것 같아. 오래도록 기억할 거야.
lines.en: I'd cry with emotion. I'd remember it for a long time.
lines.roman: gamgyeokaeseo ul geot gata. oraedorok gieokal geoya.

lines.beaver_en: Your parents would be happy too.
lines.learner: 응, 흐뭇해하실 거야. 그럼 나도 마음이 놓일 거야.
lines.en: Yeah, they'd be pleased. Then I'd feel at ease too.
lines.roman: eung, heumutaehasil geoya. geureom nado maeumi noil geoya.

lines.beaver: 우리 서로 응원하자. 내일 잘 보자!
lines.beaver_en: Let's cheer each other on. Good luck tomorrow!
lines.beaver_roman: uri seoro eungwonhaja. naeil jal boja!
lines.learner: 고마워. 이야기하니 마음이 한결 편해졌어. 화이팅!
lines.en: Thanks. Talking made me feel much better. Fighting!
lines.roman: gomawo. iyagihani maeumi hangyeol pyeonhaejyeosseo. hwaiting!
